declaration.preface:
At Shenzhen Xingbiao Electronic Technology Co Ltd, we are firmly committed to upholding the highest standards of human and labour rights across all our operations. We believe that protecting the dignity, health, safety, and well-being of every employee is essential to our success and sustainability.

Our Human and Labour Rights Policy is built on principles of fairness, respect, and equality. It covers key areas such as safe working conditions, fair compensation, freedom of association, and open communication. We continuously evaluate and improve our practices to ensure a respectful, inclusive, and compliant workplace that supports the rights of all employees.
declaration.declaration:
Driven by our core values, Shenzhen Xingbiao Electronic Technology Co Ltd is dedicated to embedding human and labour rights into the heart of our organizational practices. We foster a workplace culture that promotes safety, mutual respect, fair compensation, and open communication.

This policy is designed to protect employee rights at every stage of employment, while actively advancing diversity, equity, and inclusion. Through continual improvement, we aim to uphold human rights standards and make a meaningful contribution to the communities we serve.
declaration.scope: This policy applies to all employees, workers, subcontractors, and other stakeholders directly affiliated with us. The applicable sites include:

focusAreas: Social Dialogue and Freedom of Association
Respect for External Stakeholders and Human Rights

Worker & Employee Health and Safety: Offer health insurance coverage to address medical needs and enhance employee welfare.
Maintain a hazard-free workplace through routine risk assessments and preventive measures.
Enforce Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) to promote workplace safety and comply with health regulations.
Provide ongoing training on health and safety topics, including hazard awareness, emergency protocols, and proper use of personal protective equipment (PPE).
Support psychological health and well-being by promoting a respectful workplace and preventing work-related stress.
Employee Career Growth: Conduct regular training programs to build employee skills and align them with evolving business needs.
Provide access to career counselling services to support personal and professional growth.
Ensure performance evaluations are fair, transparent, and geared toward identifying development opportunities.
Implement a structured Career Management Plan to guide long-term career progression.
Workplace Conditions: Guarantee fair wages and reasonable working hours in line with local labour laws and industry benchmarks.
Support work-life balance by offering flexible work arrangements where operationally feasible.
Provide comprehensive social benefits, including healthcare, paid leave, and wellness initiatives.
Maintain a respectful, inclusive, and non-discriminatory workplace that values diversity and equal opportunity.
Fair Compensation and Benefits: Provide wages that are fair, competitive, and compliant with applicable labour laws and industry standards.
Uphold the principle of equal pay for equal work, free from any form of discrimination.
Offer a well-rounded benefits package, including healthcare, paid time off, and retirement provisions to support employee well-being.
Social Dialogue and Freedom of Associati: Respect the right of employees to form or join trade unions and worker committees.
Engage in constructive dialogue with employee representatives.
Resolve conflicts through fair negotiation and mediation.
Respect for External Stakeholders and Hu: Assess human rights impacts on communities where we operate.
Engage with stakeholders and address concerns transparently.
Integrate human rights criteria into contractor evaluations.
Discrimination and Harassment: Maintain a zero-tolerance policy against discrimination, harassment, and any form of unfair treatment.
Foster an inclusive workplace that upholds dignity, mutual respect, and equal opportunities for all employees, regardless of gender, age, race, religion, disability, or background.
Conduct regular training sessions to educate employees and managers on workplace conduct, unconscious bias, and anti-discrimination laws.

policy.monitoring:
Shenzhen Xingbiao Electronic Technology Co Ltd maintains a structured reporting system to ensure transparency, accountability, and continuous improvement in labour and human rights practices.

Conducts regular evaluations of policy implementation, employee training participation, and internal audit results.

Monitors compliance with applicable labour laws, workplace safety standards, and ethical policies.

Benchmarks performance against industry norms to drive improvement in governance and employee well-being.

Maintains confidential and easily accessible channels for employees and stakeholders to report labour or human rights concerns.

Ensures prompt, structured investigations with defined resolution timelines.

Analysis incident data to identify recurring trends and enhance risk mitigation measures.

Engages regularly with employees, suppliers, and external stakeholders to review and enhance human rights practices.

Delivers periodic training and awareness programs to reinforce policy compliance.

Updates internal policies based on stakeholder feedback, audit findings, and evolving industry standards.

This reporting framework strengthens Shenzhen Xingbiao Electronic Technology Co Ltd’s commitment to ethical conduct, legal compliance, and continuous development of responsible labour practices.

If required, the company may revise the policy at any time to address emerging issues or regulatory changes.
